digest.component_or_area: LLM subsystem config cutover (llm/, llm/plan_review/, llm/workflow/)
propositions: 23 below-seam ambient config reads in LLM subsystem paths are flagged as LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS and must be routed through owned seam resolvers or marked with per-line read-via annotations

19 composed-config reads (12 load_config calls plus 7 environment-variable reads) must be cut-to-seam through owned resolvers in config.py/_config_sources.py with live-per-call semantics matching original behavior

4 non-composed reads (kill-switches and protocol env-control in gate_context.py, gate_ops.py, executor.py, interpreter.py) are permitted in-place with read-via markers and a strict cap of 4 marked lines total
The 23 LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS rows must be removed and check_config_ownership.py must pass with zero findings for the 21 listed file paths
Live-per-call timing guarantees must be preserved so mid-operation environment overrides are observed after config reads are cut to seam
Behavioral test suites and operation-snapshot fingerprints must remain green/unchanged except for recorded deltas
